verdict.rationale: The Apple M4 Max is a hardware processor (SoC), so versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy are a category error for this kind of product. The evidence mentions Metal 4 and MLX, but these are Apple platform software frameworks, not APIs the chip itself ships. No deprecation policy is documented for them either, so the exception for an actually-shipped capability does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
